record.paper: Polynomial bounds for chromatic number VI. Adding a four-vertex path

dossier_meta.paper: Polynomial bounds for chromatic number VI. Adding a four-vertex path
dossier_meta.statement_text: Perhaps every forest is good (i.e., for every forest $H$, the class of $H$-free graphs is polynomially $\chi$-bounded).
dossier_meta.context_text: After recalling that Esperet's conjecture that every $\chi$-bounded hereditary class is polynomially $\chi$-bounded was disproved, the authors ask which hereditary classes are polynomially $\chi$-bounded and raise in particular whether the Gyárfás-Sumner conjecture can be strengthened to polynomial $\chi$-boundedness. They note that among trees, only those not containing $P_5$ are currently known to be good, and that it is not even known whether $P_5$ is good.
